name: Mozzart
note: General and title sponsor of KK Partizan since 2022 (the club plays as Partizan Mozzart Bet); Mozzart logo on the front of the 2026/27 jersey. Owned by Mozzart d.o.o. of Belgrade, registered to 36 private owners; largest: Jadranka Stepanović 40.98%, Dejan Čakajac 38.35% (CompanyWall register data, October 2026). Propose: none (private company; no state in the chain, no record found). Await maintainer.
